verdict.rationale: Intel documents a dedicated NPU in every Core Ultra chip and publishes a TOPS figure of up to 48 NPU TOPS for Core Ultra Series 2 (Lunar Lake). OpenVINO ships today with a documented NPU inference device, and VTune Profiler supports NPU analysis, so the accelerator is clearly exposed to developers. Missing for 10: the TOPS figure's precision (e.g., INT8) is not stated, there is no 258V-specific TOPS number (only the series 'up to' figure), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of NPU SDK use.
